title: The Story Told From the Side Character
short_teaser: Writers sometimes retell a familiar story from the perspective of someone who was barely noticed in the original.
story: Writers sometimes retell a familiar story from the perspective of someone who was barely noticed in the original. The shift can reveal assumptions and new emotional truths. Changing the point of view can change the entire meaning of the story. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Changing the point of view can change the entire meaning of the story. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning.
spark_application: Make a rough version of one idea before judging it. Give yourself ten minutes to explore rather than perfect. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
